It serves as a registry for evaluating EEG-based non-invasive BCI algorithms.
Maintained by Berlin BCI, it remains useful for benchmarking signal processing methods.

It supports benchmarking non-invasive BCI methods such as motor imagery and P300.
The registry helps researchers compare algorithms across standardized data sets.

It is widely used to benchmark non-invasive BCI classification pipelines.
The page provides metadata, download links, and citation information.

items.title_zh: MOABB修复moabb.run中-e参数被拆分问题
items.title_en: MOABB fixes -e flag splitting in moabb.run
bullets_zh: 修复moabb.run的-e参数，避免其值被拆成单个字符。
提升MOABB EEG脑机接口基准运行的命令行可复现性。
在CLI回归后保持关键非侵入式BCI评估工具稳定。
bullets_en: Fixes the -e flag in moabb.run so its value is no longer split into characters.
Improves command-line reproducibility for MOABB EEG BCI benchmark runs.
Keeps a key non-invasive BCI evaluation toolkit stable after a CLI regression.
items.brief: MOABB修复CLI参数解析，提升EEG基准可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB fixes CLI argument parsing to improve reproducible EEG benchmark runs.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix the -e flag of moabb.run splitting its value into characters (#1179)

防止TRCA和TRCSP基准流程出现兼容性中断。
支持对非侵入式EEG脑机接口算法进行可靠评估。
bullets_en: Updates MOABB code to match the pyRiemann mean API.
Prevents compatibility breakage in TRCA and TRCSP benchmark pipelines.
Supports reliable evaluation of non-invasive EEG BCI algorithms.
items.brief: MOABB适配pyRiemann API，保障TRCA/TRCSP基准流程。
